COVENANT NOT TO SUE

THIS COVENANT NOT TO SUE (this "Covenant") is granted as of July 21, 2026, by BRAMBLEWICK ORGANICS COOPERATIVE, an Oregon cooperative corporation ("Covenantor"), in favor of HOLLIS CREEK PACKING COMPANY, an Oregon corporation ("Covenantee").

RECITALS

A. Covenantor is the owner of U.S. Patent No. 11,482,996, titled "Modified Atmosphere Packaging for Perishable Produce," and U.S. Patent No. 11,733,104, titled "Vent Geometry for Corrugated Produce Cartons" (together, the "Patents").

B. Covenantor asserted that Covenantee's HC-400 carton line infringes claims of the Patents, and Covenantee denied infringement and asserted that the claims are invalid.

C. Rather than litigate, the parties have agreed that Covenantor will grant the covenant set forth below, without granting a license and without any admission by either party.

NOW, THEREFORE, for good and valuable consideration, the receipt and sufficiency of which are acknowledged, Covenantor agrees as follows.

1. Covenant.

Covenantor irrevocably and unconditionally covenants that it will not sue, assert, or otherwise pursue against Covenantee, or against Covenantee's customers, distributors, and end users, any claim, demand, or cause of action for infringement of the Patents arising from the manufacture, use, sale, offer for sale, importation, or distribution of the Covered Products, whether such acts occurred before or occur after the date of this Covenant.

2. Covered Products.

"Covered Products" means the HC-400 corrugated produce carton line as described on Schedule A, including any variant that differs only in dimensions, print, or corrugation grade, and any successor product that does not add a feature described in the claims listed on Schedule B.

3. Not a License.

This Covenant is a covenant not to sue and is not a license. Covenantee acquires no right, title, or interest in the Patents, no right to sublicense, no right to practice any claim outside the Covered Products, and no right to enforce the Patents against any person. Nothing in this Covenant exhausts, or is intended to exhaust, Covenantor's rights in the Patents beyond the Covered Products.

4. Scope and Limits.

This Covenant extends only to the Patents and only to the Covered Products. It does not extend to any other patent Covenantor owns or later acquires, to any product other than a Covered Product, or to any claim other than one for patent infringement. Covenantor retains every right to enforce the Patents against any person other than Covenantee and the categories named in Section 1.

5. Running with the Patents.

This Covenant binds Covenantor and any successor, assignee, or exclusive licensee of the Patents. Covenantor shall not assign, sell, or exclusively license either Patent unless the transferee agrees in writing to be bound by this Covenant, and any purported transfer without that agreement is void as against Covenantee.

6. No Challenge Obligation.

Nothing in this Covenant obligates Covenantee to refrain from challenging the validity, enforceability, or scope of the Patents in any forum, and Covenantor waives any argument that Covenantee's acceptance of this Covenant estops such a challenge.

7. No Admission.

This Covenant is not an admission by Covenantor that any claim of the Patents is invalid or unenforceable, nor an admission by Covenantee that any Covered Product infringes any claim. It is not admissible in any proceeding except one to enforce its terms.

8. Representations.

Covenantor represents that it is the sole owner of the Patents, that no exclusive license to the Patents is outstanding, that it has not assigned any right to sue for past infringement of the Patents to any person, and that the person signing has authority to bind Covenantor.

9. Termination.

This Covenant is irrevocable and perpetual as to acts occurring at any time, and does not terminate on expiration of either Patent, on any breach by Covenantee of any other agreement, or on any change of control of either party.

10. Governing Law and Forum.

This Covenant is governed by the laws of the State of Oregon, without regard to its conflict-of-laws principles, except that questions of patent validity, enforceability, and infringement are governed by the patent laws of the United States. The parties consent to the exclusive jurisdiction of the United States District Court for the District of Oregon.

11. Entire Agreement; Amendment; Counterparts.

This Covenant is the entire agreement of the parties concerning its subject matter. It may be amended only in a writing signed by both parties, may be executed in counterparts, and an electronic signature has the same effect as an original.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, Covenantor has executed this Covenant as of the date first written above.
